name: boom
description: Plays a vine-boom and shows the error whenever something goes wrong.

boom.triggers.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Boom when a **new** problem (red squiggle) appears in the Problems panel.

boom.triggers.tasks.description: Boom when a VS Code task (Terminal > Run Task) exits with a non-zero code.

boom.triggers.terminal.description: Boom when a command typed in the integrated terminal exits with a non-zero code (needs shell integration).

boom.diagnostics.minSeverity.description: Lowest diagnostic severity that triggers a boom.

boom.diagnostics.debounceMs.description: Wait this long after diagnostics stop changing before booming, so half-typed code doesn't trigger it.

boom.diagnostics.ignoreSources.markdownDescription: Diagnostic sources to ignore, e.g. `["cSpell", "markdownlint"]`. The source is shown in grey after each message in the Problems panel.

boom.sound.markdownDescription: The sound to play. A bundled sound (`boom`, `pipe`, `bonk`), the name of a file in your sounds folder (without extension, e.g. `vine-boom`), or an absolute path. Easiest: run **Boom: Pick a sound…**.

boom.sounds.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Sound for new problems. Empty = use `#boom.sound#`.

boom.sounds.tasks.markdownDescription: Sound for failed tasks. Empty = use `#boom.sound#`.

boom.sounds.terminal.markdownDescription: Sound for failed terminal commands. Empty = use `#boom.sound#`.

boom.soundsDir.markdownDescription: Folder with your own sounds (`.wav` works with every player). Empty = `~/.config/boom/sounds`.

boom.showMessage.description: Show the error as a notification.

enumDescriptions: Only play the sound (and the notification, if enabled).
Focus the Problems panel (diagnostics) or the terminal (tasks/commands).
Jump to the offending line (diagnostics); otherwise same as panel.
boom.reveal.description: What to bring into focus when booming.

scripts.install-ext: npm run compile && npm run package && code --install-extension boom.vsix --force
